title: Russian Drone Strike on Marhanets High-Rise Kills Three-Month-Old Infant, Injures 11
detail: Russian forces struck a multi-story residential building in Marhanets, Dnipropetrovsk Oblast, with drones in a nighttime attack, killing a three-month-old boy and injuring 11 people — seven hospitalized in serious condition, including a 5-year-old boy and a 12-year-old girl — according to Regional Military Administration chief Oleksandr Hanzha. The strike was part of a broader overnight Russian barrage of 152 strike drones (Shahed-type, Gerbera, Bandero loitering munitions, and Parodiya decoys) launched from multiple Russian regions and occupied Donetsk; Ukrainian forces shot down or suppressed 124 of them. Elsewhere in the barrage, drones hit Zaporizhzhia's Epicentr shopping center and an industrial facility, and struck a footwear factory in Odesa Oblast's Bilhorod-Dnistrovskyi district.

media.caption: Russian drone strike on a Marhanets apartment building kills a three-month-old infant, August 15, 2026
